governance_object: Governance systems (conformity-assessment bodies designated by Member States) and their identifying symbols
function: information provision (notification to the Commission)
instrument: notification of designated bodies and identifying symbols (notification-system family)
direct_text_elements: Member States; shall notify; the Commission; bodies established in the Community and their identifying symbols; bodies designated for certification, product checks and associated surveillance tasks pertaining to the procedures referred to in Article 9
inferred_elements: Designation act presupposed by 'which they have designated' (tense), not stated as an operative duty or power here. Cross-reference 'procedures referred to in Article 9' resolved by consulting Art 9(1)-(2) (EC type-examination / declaration of conformity; Annexes I-IV): resolution of wording only.
authority_note: Obligation on Member States. No capacity of the Commission over the bodies (approval, objection, listing) is stated in this statement.
discretion_note: Not coded. No choice indicators in the statement; discretion over who is designated is not stated here.
accountability_note: Information duty only. No forum assessment, explanation or consequence stated: not accountability.
position_note: Prior designation is presupposed by tense; no order rule stated between designation and notification. No gateway, option or substitutability stated.
decision_reason: Both parties (Member States, Commission), direction, modality and information content are expressed: typed information/notification relation accepted at relation level. Designation relation deferred (presupposed, not operative). Commission oversight rejected (receipt of a notification is not oversight).

governance_object: Governance systems (test laboratories designated by Member States)
function: information provision (information to the Commission)
instrument: information to the Commission on designated test laboratories
direct_text_elements: Member States; shall inform; the Commission; test laboratories established in the Community designated for carrying out tests pertaining to the procedures referred to in Article 9
inferred_elements: Designation presupposed ('which they have designated'); Art 9 cross-reference resolved as for CS-P03-001. Frozen excerpt is the first sentence of Art 10(2) only.
authority_note: Obligation on Member States; no Commission capacity stated.
discretion_note: Not coded.
position_note: As CS-P03-001; no order, gateway, option or substitutability stated.
decision_reason: Same parties, direction and relation type as CS-P03-001 (verb 'inform' instead of 'notify'; object laboratories instead of bodies): second supporting statement for R-P03-01. Split by object tested in O8 (S-01).

governance_object: Organizations/processes: a quality system (whose system is not stated in the statement)
function: verification/assurance (assessment of a quality system)
instrument: assessment of the quality system (Annex III production quality assurance procedure)
direct_text_elements: notified body; shall assess; the quality system; to determine whether it satisfies the requirements referred to in point 3.2
inferred_elements: Whose quality system: not in the statement; the manufacturer's, per Annex III points 2, 3.1 (wider text consulted for wording; not used as relationship support).
authority_note: Capacity to assess is stated. The legal consequence of the assessment is not stated in this statement (binding effect, approval status, market access not coded).
discretion_note: Not coded. 'Determine whether' states an evaluative task; no criteria, range or reviewability stated in the statement.
position_note: No order, gateway, option or substitutability stated in the statement.
relationship_ids: R-P03-02[corroborating only; not counted as support]
decision_reason: Counterparty (owner of the quality system) is not expressed in the statement; retained as a normative assignment. R-P03-02 stands on CS-P03-005; this statement contributes function/object only.

governance_object: Information: the assessment decision and its stated contents, addressed to the manufacturer
function: information provision (notification of a decision)
instrument: notification of the decision containing conclusions of the examination and the reasoned assessment decision
direct_text_elements: decision; shall be notified; the manufacturer; the notification shall contain the conclusions of the examination and the reasoned assessment decision
inferred_elements: none supplied. A contextual reading (decision = the result of the assessment in the preceding sentence of point 3.3; notifier = notified body) is available but not adopted.
authority_note: Not coded: the decision-maker and notifier are not expressed.
discretion_note: Not coded.
accountability_note: Contents requirement (conclusions plus reasoned decision) is a justification component addressed to the manufacturer, but with no identified actor, no assessment forum and no consequence it is not coded as accountability.
position_note: 'The decision' presupposes a prior decision step; order assessment -> decision -> notification is implied by the noun, not stated as a rule.
decision_reason: Passive construction: the notifying actor is not expressed. No actor is supplied by inference; relation deferred pending human review. Sensitivity S-03 tests the contextual reading.

governance_object: Organizations/processes: the manufacturer's maintenance and application of the quality system
function: monitoring / verification (surveillance audit) - uncertain_boundary between the two
instrument: periodic audit (surveillance audit of the quality system)
direct_text_elements: notified body; shall carry out audits; at reasonable intervals; to make sure that the manufacturer maintains and applies the quality system
inferred_elements: none (manufacturer is expressed in the object clause). Identical wording appears in Annex IV 4.3 (wider text consulted); anchor stays Annex III per register.
authority_note: Capacity to audit is stated; consequence of audit findings (e.g., withdrawal or sanction) not stated.
discretion_note: Indicator: open-textured 'reasonable intervals' gives some choice over timing. Range, specificity of constraint, reviewability and justification not stated: no level coded.
accountability_note: Audit of the manufacturer; no forum-to-which-the-auditor-answers stated. Not accountability of the notified body; for the manufacturer the audit is an assessment component, with no consequence stated.
position_note: Recurrence 'at reasonable intervals' is a temporal modulation, not a sequence rule. Order relative to point 3.3 assessment not stated in the statement.
decision_reason: Parties (notified body; manufacturer, expressed in the object clause), direction, modality and a governance-relevant action (audit to verify maintenance and application of the quality system) are all in the text: verification/assurance relation accepted.

governance_object: Information: the audit report addressed to the manufacturer
function: information provision (audit reporting back to the audited party)
instrument: audit report
direct_text_elements: notified body; shall provide; an audit report; to the manufacturer; (audit activity in the same sentence)
inferred_elements: none. That the report follows the audit is entailed by 'audit report', not by an explicit sequencing rule.
authority_note: None stated for the manufacturer as recipient.
discretion_note: Not coded.
accountability_note: Report goes to the audited party, not to a forum with assessment capacity over the notified body: information relation, not accountability.
position_note: Coordinate action after the audit within one sentence; temporal order entailed by the noun, not stated as a rule.
decision_reason: Parties, direction and recipient are expressed: typed information relation (distinct from the verification relation R-P03-02).

governance_object: Governance systems/process: the phased-registration period (audit object per wider text of Art 12(5), third sentence: administration of phased registration by the Registry)
function: verification/assurance (audit) and information provision (reporting findings)
instrument: independent audit (performed at the expense of the Registry; findings reported to the Commission)
direct_text_elements: independent audit; shall be performed; at the end of the phased registration; at the expense of the Registry; shall report its findings to the Commission
inferred_elements: (a) identification of the audit's performer with 'the auditor' of CS-P04-002 (same paragraph); (b) audit object: the Registry's operational and technical administration of the phased registration, from the third sentence of Art 12(5), outside the frozen excerpt (consulted to resolve 'audit of what').
authority_note: Capacity to audit and report stated; the audit's consequence for the Registry or the Commission's response is not stated.
discretion_note: Not coded.
accountability_note: Components present: information (findings to the Commission) and an independent assessment (audit). Absent: Registry explanation, Commission assessment or response, consequence. Accountability not established.
position_note: Explicit time marker 'at the end of the phased registration'; report follows audit ('its findings'). No gateway, option or substitutability stated.
decision_reason: Report-to-Commission relation accepted on the grammatical subject (provisional, human review). Audit-of-Registry relation accepted only via wider same-paragraph wording. Cost-bearing (no payee expressed), Registry-to-Commission accountability (components missing) and audit-of-validation-agents (contextual membership only) rejected.

governance_object: Governance systems: the auditor (appointment of the verifier)
function: designation of a verifier (evidence-supported equivalent; implementation of the audit provision) - uncertain_boundary
instrument: appointment of the auditor
modality: shall (obligation; passive 'shall be appointed' with express appointing institution)
direct_text_elements: the auditor; shall be appointed; by the Registry; after consulting the Commission
inferred_elements: none. The sentence is passive but states the appointing institution.
authority_note: Registry's appointing capacity is stated. Whether the Commission's view binds the Registry is not stated: no Commission authority over the appointment is coded.
discretion_note: Indicator: a procedural constraint (prior consultation). No substantive criteria for choosing the auditor stated; range not coded.
accountability_note: None stated for the auditor toward the appointing Registry (no reporting duty to the Registry is stated in the statements).
position_note: Explicit order: consulting the Commission precedes appointment ('after consulting'). Consultation is not consent (contrast CS-P04-010).
decision_reason: Registry -> auditor appointment is expressed. The consultation clause names the Commission and an action (consulting) with a precedence marker: a thin participation relation accepted with no authority attributed to the Commission.

governance_object: Governance systems: validation agents (selection of verifiers)
function: designation of verifiers (evidence-supported equivalent) - uncertain_boundary
instrument: selection of validation agents
direct_text_elements: Registry; shall select; the validation agents; in an objective, transparent and non-discriminatory manner; ensuring the widest possible geographical diversity
inferred_elements: none
authority_note: Registry's selecting capacity is stated; what status the selection confers on the agents is not stated in this statement.
discretion_note: Indicators: open-textured standards constrain the choice ('objective, transparent, non-discriminatory'; 'widest possible geographical diversity'). Range and reviewability not stated: no level coded.
position_note: No order, gateway, option or substitutability stated.
decision_reason: Registry and validation agents (actor category) are expressed with a governance-relevant action (selection) and stated manner.

governance_object: Conduct of validation agents in executing validation
function: implementation (requiring conduct standards of a verifier) - uncertain_boundary
mechanism: command (requirement); means of requiring not stated
instrument: requirement imposed on the validation agent (means unspecified)
direct_text_elements: Registry; shall require; the validation agent; to execute the validation; in an objective, transparent and non-discriminatory manner
inferred_elements: none
authority_note: Registry's duty to require conduct is stated. The means (contract, rule) and any consequence of non-compliance are not stated: control capacity beyond the requirement is not coded.
discretion_note: Not coded for the Registry. For the agent, open-textured standards constrain execution; range not coded.
accountability_note: None stated: no duty of the agent to answer to the Registry is stated here.
position_note: Time relation of the requirement to the validation (ex ante or continuing) is not stated.
decision_reason: Both parties and a directive action are expressed: control (requirement) relation accepted. Delegation of decision authority is not stated and is deferred.

governance_object: Information: documentary evidence of a claimed prior right
function: information provision (evidence submission to a verifier)
instrument: documentary evidence submission (validation procedure)
direct_text_elements: every applicant; shall submit; documentary evidence that shows he or she is the holder of the prior right claimed on the name; to a validation agent indicated by the Registry
inferred_elements: none. Deadline for receipt (forty days) exists in wider text and is not part of this statement.
authority_note: Duty on applicants; no authority attributed.
discretion_note: Not coded.
accountability_note: Information duty to a verifier; not accountability.
position_note: Agent 'indicated by the Registry': allocation step stated by participle but recipient and process unstated. Submission must precede examination (see CS-P04-006 condition).
decision_reason: Applicant and validation agent expressed with direction and modality: information relation accepted. Registry's indication of the agent has no stated recipient and is deferred (no designation relation inferred).

governance_object: The first-in-line applicant's claim to prior rights on the name
function: verification/assurance (examination of a prior-rights claim)
instrument: examination of the documentary evidence (validation)
direct_text_elements: relevant validation agent; shall examine; whether the applicant first in line to be assessed for a domain name and having submitted documentary evidence before the deadline has prior rights on the name
inferred_elements: 'Deadline' and 'first in line' resolved with Art 14 wider text (forty-day receipt deadline; examination in order of receipt): wording only.
authority_note: Capacity to examine stated; the statement does not decide whether rights exist, and the legal effect of the finding is not stated.
discretion_note: Indicator: 'examine whether' is an evaluative task. No criteria beyond the documentary evidence, no reviewability stated: no level coded.
position_note: Explicit conditions: applicant first in line; evidence submitted before the deadline (so submission precedes examination).
decision_reason: Validation agent and the applicant (as examined party) are expressed: verification relation accepted. Consequence of the finding not stated, so no authority level is coded.

governance_object: Information: late or insufficient documentary evidence (examination outcome, negative)
function: information provision (notification of outcome to the Registry)
instrument: notification to the Registry
direct_text_elements: validation agent; shall notify; the Registry; if the documentary evidence has not been received in time OR if the agent finds it does not substantiate a prior right
inferred_elements: none (the antecedent of 'of this' is the stated condition; 'deadline' resolved by wider text as for CS-P04-006)
authority_note: Duty to notify; the Registry's capacity on receipt is not stated in this statement.
discretion_note: Not coded; the agent's finding that evidence does not substantiate a right involves judgment but no range/constraint is stated.
accountability_note: Information to the Registry; no Registry assessment or consequence stated: not accountability.
position_note: Notification follows the stated trigger (late receipt or adverse finding). Alternatives 'or' are textual.
decision_reason: Parties, direction, modality and conditions expressed: information relation, supported jointly with CS-P04-008.

governance_object: Information: finding that prior rights exist for a first-in-line application (positive outcome)
function: information provision (notification of outcome to the Registry)
instrument: notification to the Registry
direct_text_elements: validation agent; shall notify; the Registry; if the agent finds that prior rights exist regarding the application for a domain name first in line
inferred_elements: none
authority_note: As CS-P04-007: legal effect of the notified finding is not stated.
discretion_note: Not coded.
position_note: Notification follows the agent's positive finding. Complementary to CS-P04-007's adverse triggers; mutual exclusivity inferred from content, not stated.
decision_reason: Same parties and relation type as CS-P04-007 with the complementary condition; positive and negative notifications are kept as separate statements and joined only at relation level.

governance_object: Governance arrangement: an escrow agreement with a trustee/escrow agent (purpose not stated in the statement)
function: uncertain (data-safeguarding arrangement; purpose not stated in the 20 statements) - uncertain_boundary
instrument: escrow agreement (contractual / risk-transfer family) designating the Commission as beneficiary
direct_text_elements: Registry; shall, at its own expense, enter into an agreement; reputable trustee or other escrow agent established within the Community; designating the Commission as the beneficiary of the escrow agreement
inferred_elements: none. Terms of the beneficiary position are in wider text (Art 15(2)); not used.
authority_note: Registry's duty to contract stated; the Commission's rights as beneficiary are not stated in the statement.
discretion_note: Not coded.
position_note: Order relative to Commission consent: consent must precede conclusion (CS-P04-010). Order relative to data submission not stated.
decision_reason: Registry and escrow agent (category) expressed: contractual relation accepted. Commission named as beneficiary: thin beneficiary-designation relation accepted without content. Escrow agent -> Commission duty rejected (no action toward the Commission stated).

governance_object: The escrow agreement (an instrument) before its conclusion
function: approval of an instrument (evidence-supported equivalent of authorization/oversight) - uncertain_boundary
instrument: consent to the escrow agreement
modality: shall (obligation; mandatory form, effect of withholding not stated)
direct_text_elements: Commission; shall give its consent; to that agreement; before it is concluded
inferred_elements: 'That agreement' read as the agreement of CS-P04-009 (anaphora in the same paragraph); hence the Registry is the counterpart. The statement itself names no counterpart.
authority_note: Consent capacity stated. Whether the Commission may refuse, and whether the agreement's validity depends on consent, are not stated.
discretion_note: Not inferred: 'shall give its consent' is mandatory in form, so absence or presence of discretion cannot be read from the modality or from the Commission's institutional role.
position_note: Explicit precedence: consent before conclusion (precondition on conclusion of the agreement). Gateway for anything beyond the conclusion of the agreement is not stated.
decision_reason: Commission is expressed; counterpart through the demonstrative 'that agreement' (a stated cross-reference within Art 15(1)). Approval relation accepted at cross_provision_inference with human review.

governance_object: Information: an electronic copy of the current content of the .eu database
function: information provision (data deposit with a third party)
instrument: daily electronic copy deposit to the escrow agent
direct_text_elements: Registry; shall submit; to the escrow agent; on a daily basis; an electronic copy of the current content of the .eu database
inferred_elements: 'The escrow agent' read as the agent of the agreement of CS-P04-009 (definite article within Art 15(1)).
authority_note: Duty on Registry; no authority attributed to the escrow agent.
discretion_note: Not coded.
position_note: Recurring ('daily basis'). Temporal order after the agreement is entailed by the definite 'the escrow agent' but not stated as a rule.
decision_reason: Registry and escrow agent expressed with direction, modality and recurrence.

actor_coded: NOT_EXPRESSED_IN_SENTENCE (submitter of complaints and responses); complainant expressed only as chooser of the provider
governance_object: Information: complaints and responses addressed to an ADR provider
function: dispute resolution (intake/routing stage only) - uncertain_boundary
instrument: ADR complaint procedure
direct_text_elements: complaints and responses; must be submitted; to an ADR provider chosen by the complainant from the list referred to in the first paragraph of Article 23
inferred_elements: 'The list' resolved with Art 23(1) wider text: a published list of the ADR providers the Registry selects.
authority_note: Complainant's choice among listed providers is stated; no authority of the provider is stated in this statement.
discretion_note: Indicator: choice among alternatives (provider chosen by the complainant from a list). Range = the list; constraint and reviewability not stated: no level coded.
position_note: The list must exist before the choice (entailed by the cross-reference). Option: complainant chooses among listed providers. Submission of responses by an unexpressed party is not positioned.
decision_reason: Passive: the submitter(s) are not expressed; no party inferred. The complainant -> provider choice, which is expressed in the condition, is accepted as a separate thin relation.

governance_object: Information: identity of the complainant and the domain name involved
function: information provision (notification to the Registry)
instrument: ADR procedure (provider-to-Registry information step)
direct_text_elements: ADR provider; shall inform; the Registry; of the identity of the complainant and the domain name involved; as soon as a request for ADR is properly filed with the ADR provider and the appropriate fee is paid
inferred_elements: none. The remainder of Art 22(6) is outside the frozen excerpt and not evaluated.
authority_note: No authority stated for either party in this statement.
discretion_note: Not coded ('properly filed' and 'appropriate' are undefined in the statement).
position_note: Explicit trigger: filing plus fee payment ('as soon as'), then information. Complaint intake precedes the information step.
decision_reason: Parties, direction, modality, trigger conditions expressed.

governance_object: Governance systems: ADR providers (selection of dispute-resolution bodies)
function: designation of dispute-resolution providers (evidence-supported equivalent) - uncertain_boundary
instrument: selection of ADR providers (list published per wider text)
direct_text_elements: Registry; may select; ADR providers; who shall be reputable bodies with appropriate expertise; in an objective, transparent and non-discriminatory manner
inferred_elements: none in the statement. The 'list' sentence of Art 23(1) is the target of the cross-reference in CS-P04-012 (consulted).
authority_note: Registry's selecting capacity stated as permission; consequence of selection (inclusion in a list) via wider text only.
discretion_note: Indicators: permissive 'may'; open-textured qualifications and manner standards. Range, specificity of constraint, reviewability not stated: no level coded.
position_note: Permissive, not obligatory. Option set for CS-P04-012 depends on its exercise (by cross-reference).
decision_reason: Registry and ADR providers (category) expressed with action (selection) and permissive modality. Post-selection supervision rejected (selection is not supervision).
